blockers.wanted: tell the latch click level from the body level in one number (click-to-body ratio)
blockers.tried: read the 2k and 125 Hz band rows of segment 0 and compared by eye
blockers.workaround: bands check on 63 Hz seg 1 and 2k seg 0 plus zoom listen on 0-80 ms

blockers.wanted: assert two events (click then release) with spacing_ms 5
blockers.tried: onsets {count: 2}; then spacing_ms 5 which reports 5 onsets for one latch (press, release, ringing)
blockers.workaround: default spacing (40 ms): 2 onsets, min 1 max 3

blockers.wanted: a body that peaks within 5 ms under a 150 Hz lowpass
blockers.tried: body 12 ms and 20 ms after the click: overall attack 16-21 ms because the body (normalized) is louder than the click
blockers.workaround: put the contact 2 ms after the click, mass 1 hardness 0.9, body gain 0.3 so the click is the peak; attack 3.7-4.2 ms (swell 4.2 ms). Click-then-body order is kept only by 2 ms

wishlist: a modal/body 'lowpass' or max_hz field so a body under 150 Hz needs no separate filter and decay
a click-to-body level ratio in listen
a door/thud preset node (hinge-held panel with damped ring)
what_worked: click kind latch gave a two-snick transient with the attack in one node
contact -> modal wood size 1.4 gave 44 and 130 Hz modes at once
macros with claims passed first try (weight, latch, length)
